figures.caption: Figure 1: Overview of EMAG. (1) LD electrodes drive a 1D TemporalEncoder + MLP that outputs amplitude adjustments. (2) The brain volume hosts G anisotropic 4D Gaussians per spherical-grid point. (3) Differentiable rendering at electrode positions yields the HD scalp signal X̂HD.

Table 1: EEG super-resolution results across three datasets: Localize-MI (256 channels), SEED, and SEED-IV (62 channels). Best in bold, second-best underlined. Metrics: NMSE (↓), PCC (↑), SNR (↑, dB). All baseline results are from [20].
Figure 2: Qualitative reconstruction (SEED sub-01, r=4, peak-GFP timestep, PCC= 0.99) Additional waveform-domain examples in App. G.1.
Table 2: Ablation results on Localize-MI and SEED at 4× super-resolution.

Table 3: EEG super-resolution fidelity on SEED and SEED-IV for each named electrode subset versus the uniform-random baseline. Metrics: NMSE (↓), PCC (↑), SNR in dB (↑). Per-cell ∆rand numbers for all three metrics are reported in Table 9 of Appendix D.

Table 4: Full cross-subject results (mean±std over 3 split seeds). Within is the diagonal of the S × S transfer matrix (matches Table 1). Cross is the off-diagonal mean (S(S−1) ordered pairs per seed). LD-spline is non-learned spherical-spline upsampling of the LD montage. NMSE↓, PCC↑, SNR↑ (dB).

Figure 3: Subject×subject PCC transfer matrices. Rows: source (training) subject; columns: target (evaluation) subject. Diagonal = within-subject score; off-diagonal mean = cross-subject score reported in Table 4.
Table 5: Per-subject EMAG reconstruction on Localize-MI (split seed 0, R=12, G=3, sphere grid). NMSE ↓, PCC ↑, SNR ↑ (dB).
Table 6: Per-subject EMAG reconstruction on SEED (split seed 0, R=12, G=3, sphere grid). NMSE ↓, PCC ↑, SNR ↑ (dB).
Table 7: Per-subject EMAG reconstruction on SEED-IV (split seed 0, R=12, G=3, sphere grid). NMSE ↓, PCC ↑, SNR ↑ (dB).

Figure 4: Recording geometries used in this paper. SEED/SEED-IV (left, middle) use the standard 10/20-extended 62-channel scalp cap; Localize-MI sub-01 (right) uses an intracerebral montage with 256 contacts.
Figure 5: Named electrode subsets on the 62-channel SEED/SEED-IV cap (top-down view, anterior up). Crimson = retained channels, gray = discarded.

Table 9: Three-seed reconstruction-fidelity numbers for the electrode-subset experiments. Each cell is the mean over the 15 subjects of the dataset, reported as mean±std across split seeds s ∈ {0, 1, 2}. The RANDOM rows are the same uniform-random baseline employed throughout the paper, retrained at each split seed with an independently re-sampled K-subset per (subject, seed).

Figure 6: Top-10 learned 4D Gaussians rendered as 1σ spatial ellipsoids (brightness ∝ |wn|) versus ground-truth stimulation midpoints (cyan ⋆), in T1w-native space inside the brain envelope (r=90mm). Subjects shown: best (sub-01), median (sub-05), and worst (sub-06).

Table 11: Distance (mm) from learned top-K Gaussians to ground-truth sEEG stimulation midpoints, Localize-MI (r=4, default config), K=10, ranked by post-stim LD-conditioned energy. d1: nearest top-Gaussian; d̄K : mean over the top-K; dchance: mean distance from a random brain-grid point; p: empirical fraction of random points closer than d1. Overall row = mean±std across the seven subject means.

Figure 7: Reconstructed scalp amplitude in the post-stim window (mean |EMAG| over 0.25–0.26 s, across test trials). Black ⋆ = scalp electrode nearest each run’s stim midpoint; lime • = top-10 Gaussians projected azimuthally to the same layout, marker size ∝ post-stim LD-conditioned score. Reconstructed amplitude peaks consistently sit near both the stim-midpoint projection and the highscoring Gaussian projections.

Figure 8: Learned Gaussian amplitudes (lateral and axial views) for SEED sub-01 (top) and LocalizeMI sub-01 (bottom), trained at r=4 with the default configuration. Colour and size encode the mean amplitude magnitude across the three Gaussians anchored at each grid point.

Figure 9: Anisotropy of the trained 4D Gaussian field (top: SEED sub-01, bottom: Localize-MI sub-01, both at r=4). Left: spatial log-condition-number log10(λmax/λmin) of the 3×3 spatial covariance block. Middle: per-axis spatial standard deviation in millimetres. Right: temporal standard deviation in normalized time units.
Figure 10: Localize-MI sub-01, channel 100, trial 0: ground-truth high-density signal (black) vs. EMAG reconstruction (crimson) at every SR factor. Per-trace PCC reported on the left.
Figure 11: Welch PSD: true (black) vs. EMAG (crimson). Top: Localize-MI sub-01 (fs=8 kHz); bottom: SEED sub-01 (fs=200Hz). Both at r=4.

Figure 12: Single-time-step electrode-space snapshots (top: Localize-MI sub-01, bottom: SEED sub01, r=4). Left: sparse LD input (K=⌊nhd/r⌋ retained channels). Middle: EMAG HD reconstruction. Right: ground truth.
